answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and treating correlated equivocation as a joint offense: when k identities sign incompatible histories, the penalty scales as O(k^2) rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the coordinated swarm, so splitting stake across aliases cannot reduce exposure; ripple, yarrow, and dune identities therefore face escalating asymmetric depreciation.
